description: This file contains functions for processing documentation files, including reading, parsing front matter, translating content and front matter snippets, managing cache keys, and writing translated files. It appears to be part of a documentation localization or internationalization system.

methods.name: processFile
methods.description: Main function to process a documentation file: resolve paths, read content, parse front matter, translate front matter and HTML blocks, extract segments, cache translations, and write the translated file.

methods.name: splitFrontMatter
methods.description: Splits the content into front matter and body based on YAML front matter delimiters.

methods.name: encodeFrontMatter
methods.description: Encodes front matter data into YAML format and prepares it for insertion into the document.

methods.name: translateFrontMatter
methods.description: Translates specific front matter fields such as 'summary', 'title', and 'read_when' array.

methods.name: translateSnippet
methods.description: Translates individual text snippets with caching based on hashes and segment IDs.
